_description: Hand-derived expected values for KPI baseline instrumentation validation (WO-207). Values are independently computed from the golden dataset definitions below — never generated by running the code under test.

sla_compliance_golden._description: 8 closed work orders in P30D: HIGH=3 compliant/4 total, MEDIUM=2/3, LOW=1/1. 1 CANCELLED excluded (not in analytics_closure_projection). Compliance = closed_at <= resolution_deadline (inclusive).

_derivation.HIGH: WOs GH001(60min,OK), GH002(90min,OK), GH003(120min=deadline,OK), GH004(121min>deadline,BREACH). 3 compliant / 4 total = 3/4 = 0.7500

sla_resolution_golden._description: Resolution time = created_at to closed_at in minutes. Computed per priority tier.

sla_deadline_boundary._description: Exact-deadline boundary rule: closed_at <= resolution_deadline is COMPLIANT; closed_at > resolution_deadline (even by 1 second) is a BREACH.
sla_deadline_boundary._derivation: From SlaAggregationRepository: CASE WHEN acp.closed_at <= wo.resolution_deadline THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

first_time_fix_golden._description: 4 MATURED classifiable WOs in P90D: GF001(FTF), GF002(repeat,not-FTF), GF003(FTF), GF004(FTF). 1 PROVISIONAL excluded from matured rate. 1 null-asset excluded (unclassifiable).

utilization_golden._description: 3 technicians with distinct utilization profiles. Team rollup uses sum-of-numerators (not mean of ratios). Minutes logged in a single ISO week within P7D window.

cohort_maturity._description: Work order closed 29 days ago = PROVISIONAL (matured_at in future). Closed 31 days ago = MATURED (matured_at in past). matured_at = closed_at + 30 days.
